snapshot.error-s3-bad-name: The System rejects that name. Use 2-30 letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens or periods, and nothing on the reserved list.

snapshot.error-s3-no-name: No name tag yet. Set a name first.
snapshot.help-s3:
The name goes on the paperwork. Your Broadcast Name (what the audience calls you) comes later.
It must be unique in this session. The System checks.
Pronouns are optional.

Two short lines: what you look like now, and why you are funny or dangerous.
Everyone reads as baseline human on Floors 1-2, so keep the horns for later.
No links.

snapshot.help-s8:
Factory Preset (Standard array): 15 14 13 12 10 8, each once. Layaway Plan (Point buy): 27 points, scores 8-15.
Hand in six numbers in the order STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA; the background bonus is added after.
Pain Budget (HP), Not-Getting-Hit Number (AC) and the rest are computed for you.

Pick the rest; skills you already own are hidden.

snapshot.error-s10-need-both: Pick equipment (kit or credits) for both your Provisional Class and Prior Employment.
snapshot.error-s10-overspent: You spent more credits than you have. The Wall does not extend credit.
snapshot.error-s10-pick-both: Pick both equipment options (and do not overspend). The Wall keeps score.
snapshot.error-s10-pick-type: Pick the type of each item that says "pick type" (holy symbol, gaming set, instrument, tools). The Wall does not sell mystery packages.

snapshot.error-s10-which-one: Pick which one you get: {list}. The Wall will not pick for you.
snapshot.help-s10:
Each of class and background gives a kit or a credit amount (1 gold = 1 credit).
Spend leftover credits at the Intake Vending Wall by typing names; everything is junk and everything is a real 5e item underneath.
Every item shows the System's own name with the real 5e name in brackets (from the item-reskins table); stats never change. Holy symbols, gaming sets, instruments and tools ask you to pick a type.
snapshot.hint-s10-describe: Take each kit or its credits. Everything is junk; everything works. **Credits:** {from_options} from options, {spent} spent at the Intake Vending Wall, **{left} left**.
